# Readers drawn from the selected

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`readers-drawn-from-the-selected` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](readers-drawn-from-the-selected.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A rule read by readers drawn from the population it selects reads the share exactly where each carrier reads at least as favourably for the carriers as each other does; where only the others read the loss, the counts at the step they read it decide for good whether the lock is kept or turned.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The pool reads the share: the rule read as the sum of its readers' readings, each carrier among them reading u and each other v, counted as the population counts them, is monotone in the share exactly where v is not above u. Two pools compare as a part alike on both sides and a crosswise part, one rearrangement of products. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.poolRead`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.rearrange_eq`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.rearrange`, `Becoming.Naturals.add_regroup`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.cross`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_mono`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_reads`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_reads_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
2. Where u is not above v the pool reads against the share, and along a course whose rules favour its rule read does not rise. Where the counts of readers are a monotone function of the share it still reads the share, and every reader reading favourably, every course is locked from the step after its second reading step. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_mono_against`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_against`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_not_rising`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_through`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.pool_favours`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.through_locks`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
3. Against a mirrored reading the counts decide: the others reading for the others what the carriers read for the carriers, the carriers' reading favouring them strictly, the pool favours the carriers exactly where they are at least as many as the others, and the others exactly where they are at least as many as the carriers. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.rearrange_lt`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.mirror_favours_iff`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.mirror_disfavours_iff`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.le_of_disfavours`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Drawn.mirror_le`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
4. A loss read by part of the pool: the carriers read u whatever the loss, the others v below a bound N and w from then on. Readings alike wherever the loss is at least N give one joined course, the loss accruing; so from a step at which the loss has reached N the course is the share's own loop under the pool of u and w, whose rule read is that pool at the share. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.lossPool`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.lossPool_past`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.course`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.turn_agree`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.course_past`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.past_course`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.rule_read`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* no shared law's anchor among the constants its declarations use.
5. Agreement locks for good: at a reading step at which the rule in force and the rule read both favour, the course is locked from the next step on, share and rule never below where they were. Read late, both favouring the carriers, the lock holds while the loss grows and every other reader reads it; read in time, both favouring the others, the course is locked the other way. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.agreeing_locks`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.agreeing_stays`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.read_late_kept`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.read_in_time_turns`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
6. The counts at the reading decide: with the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers', at a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound, the rule in force favouring the carriers, the course is locked for good exactly where the carriers are at least as many as the others there; the rule in force favouring the others, it is locked the other way for good exactly where the others are at least as many. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.kept_iff`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.turned_iff`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure; its declarations reach the grammar.
7. Witnesses: one carrier to eight others under a rule favouring the carriers four to one, read at every step, the loss rising by one a step; the carriers read four to one for themselves, the others one to one, then four to one for themselves once they read the loss. Read from the start, the course is locked the other way from step 2; read from step 3, it is locked for good from step 4. (`Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.fewCarriers`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.inTime`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.late`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.lossStep_accrues`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.inTime_majority`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.inTime_turned`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.late_majority`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.late_kept`, `Becoming.ClosedCapture.Thinned.late_reads_loss`)
   - *Shared laws, by Lean dependency:* closure and lumping; its declarations reach the grammar.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. Each statement names its hypotheses: the pool form (two kinds of reader, each reading alike, summed unnormalized, counted as the population counts them); the others' reading not above the carriers' (readers); for the loss, Accrues and a reading step at which the loss has reached its bound; for the counts, the others' late reading the mirror of the carriers' and the carriers' reading favouring strictly.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That any actual rule is the pool of readers drawn from those it selects, or that each kind reads at least as favourably for its own kind: within the pool ReadsShare is equivalent to that comparison, so the premise is moved to who reads, not removed.
- Readers of one kind reading differently, weights other than counts, readings formed by argument; the pool sums readings unnormalized, so a reading's size weighs with its count (mirrored readings have equal sizes).
- That the readers are minds, institutions or a culture: that is a reading (D58, D67). Nor the calibration of any of this to the present world.
- Favouring and disfavouring both hold of a rule giving each kind alike, so locked the other way says the carriers' share never rises again, not that it falls; the in-time witness shows the strict fall.
- **Counterexample:** The time of the reading is not idle: the same readers reading the same loss lock the course the other way when they read it from the start and leave it locked for good when they first read it at step 3 (Thinned.inTime_turned, Thinned.late_kept), though the late reading reads beyond the share (Thinned.late_reads_loss). <details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The meta-attractor corpus's "selecting the selectors", the passage from being selected by a rule to helping reproduce the rule that selects you, through who holds recruitment, training and evaluation; regulatory capture through who staffs the regulator (Stigler 1971); a reform carried by a minority of evaluators. Within the pool the result is the mediant property of ratios read as a monotone reading; its delta is the loss read by the part of the pool the selection thins, and the exact counts at the reading that decide the lock.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [capture-through-the-rule](capture-through-the-rule.md). Applies Becoming.RuleCapture's lock (Raises, ReadsShare, Locked, locked_stays, locked_not_below) to the pool, read either way (lowers, lower, ReadsShare.reverse), with its counts (CarrierCounts, order, favours, disfavours, select, hi, lo).
  - Output: A rule read monotonically from the share locks, and stays locked, from a locked configuration.
  - Input: The pool, shown to read the share; the agreement of rule in force and rule read at a reading step.
  - Preserved conditions: Raises, the pool's readers not above one another as stated, favouring kept upward. [RuleCapture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/RuleCapture.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [closed-capture](closed-capture.md). Builds on the share's law joined with a step beyond (join, joinRead, join_course), Accrues and loss_grows, reads_beyond_of_apart and Beyond.lossStep.
  - Output: The joined loop runs as the share's own loop where the reading reads only the share; the loss grows by at least one a step.
  - Input: The loss read by part of the pool, past its bound.
  - Preserved conditions: Accrues. [ClosedCapture.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/ClosedCapture.lean)
- related, not a proved adapter: [a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet](a-reading-against-the-share-does-not-ratchet.md). The pool whose carriers read less favourably for the carriers reads against the share, the case in which the rise the lock rests on does not form.
- related, not a proved adapter: [a-pool-read-by-its-majority](a-pool-read-by-its-majority.md). A pool read by its majority separates no more than the pool; here a pool of readings, whose counts decide the rule's direction.
- related, not a proved adapter: [shaping-read-by-readers-drawn-from-the-selected](shaping-read-by-readers-drawn-from-the-selected.md). MA4: the pool of two of RuleShaping's rules after shaping, hi coming back where a shaper reads and lo where an other does; there ReadsShare is equivalent to lo ≤ hi, and a critical mass decides the direction.
- related, not a proved adapter: [loss-read-in-time-by-the-others](loss-read-in-time-by-the-others.md). MA4b: Thinned joined to MA4's critical mass; read past the bound, the counts when the loss is read decide, exactly and with no mirror premise, and a reading turns the course only before the late reading would favour the shapers.
